description: Global GIS : Springs, wells and dams is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors United States. National Imagery and Mapping Agency. This datalayer is a point coverage representing the locations of springs/water holes/wells, dams/weirs, river rapids, and waterfalls worldwide and was published as part of the USGS Global GIS : global coverage database. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: Cite National Imagery and Mapping Agency. For educational non-commercial use only. Harvard University makes no claims, no representations, and no warr. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
